fields.summary_ko.0: Warren Buffett's successor Greg Abel concentrates $11.17B (31%) of Berkshire Hathaway's $36.3B portfolio in three AI holdings: Apple, Alphabet, and Bending Spoons.
fields.summary_ko.1: Apple Intelligence and Google Cloud generative AI revenue of $30.7B in Q3 (more than doubled) reflects Abel's technology-focused portfolio repositioning.
